recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast macro shot of a vibrant magenta crushed cosmetic powder against a solid black background. The central focus is a distinct, detailed human fingerprint pressed into the center of the pigment mound, surrounded by jagged, irregular edges of loose powder and fine blue/purple glitter particles.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic human texture vs. granular mineral texture
High-saturation magenta vs. absolute black void
Centralized vertical mass vs. scattered peripheral debris
Smooth ridge detail vs. rough crushed powder edges
coreInvariants: Deep magenta hue with cool undertones
Circular/oval fingerprint impression in the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The concentric ridges of the fingerprint at the center of the pigment mass.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the high-contrast center, moves outward to the jagged edges of the powder, then follows the scattered crumbs toward the top and bottom edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive, uniform black negative space surrounding the central object to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation magenta with varying values created by the shadows in the fingerprint ridges and the highlights on the glitter.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of a vertical mound of crushed magenta eyeshadow on a black surface. The edges should be jagged and crumbly with small specks of blue glitter. In the center, there must be a clear, deep impression of a human thumbprint showing detailed ridges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist sans-serif font in white or silver, positioned in the negative space to the left or right of the pigment mass to maintain the central focus.

verificationChecks: Is the fingerprint ridge detail sharp and clear?
Is the background pure black without noise?
Are the edges of the powder mound sufficiently irregular?
Is the magenta color vibrant and saturated?

adjustableVariables: Amount of scattered debris around the main mass
mustRedesign: Avoid smooth, circular edges for the powder; it must look crushed and organic.
Ensure the fingerprint is not a digital overlay but looks physically pressed into the material.

mustAchieve: Tactile realism in the powder texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic shadow depth within the fingerprint ridges.
Verify that glitter particles appear as tiny specular highlights.
Ensure the silhouette of the powder is vertically elongated.
Confirm no lens flare or unwanted reflections on the black surface.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro shot of [COLOR] crushed [MATERIAL] with a [TEXTURE/IMPRINT] centered on a [BACKGROUND COLOR] background, featuring [ACCENT DETAIL].
